verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly claim 'Generate new apps from PDFs, images, or sketches using multimodal capabilities,' directly matching the story, but there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific capability, and broader community feedback raises general concerns about agentic reliability that could affect complex generation tasks. missing for 10: independent hands-on demonstration of sketch/PDF-to-app generation, details on fidelity/limitations of this workflow.
